firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently visited Barcelona goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The first player takes the dice bag and begins the first pass. The second pass runs in reverse order, so the last player takes two turns in succession.
The solo variant has one human player taking both turns in each round.
